article_images.caption: This is my family.
article_images.image_prompt: Lily, Mom, Dad, and Tom stand close together in front of a house with a red door. Pip sits at their feet. Everyone smiles. Bright morning light.

article_images.caption: Grandma and Grandpa come to the house.
article_images.image_prompt: Grandma and Grandpa walk to the door of the house. Lily waves hello. Pip runs to Grandpa with his tail up.

article_images.caption: There are six of us!
article_images.image_prompt: Six people sit close together on a big sofa in the living room: Lily, Tom, Mom, Dad, Grandma, and Grandpa. Pip sits on the floor. Everyone smiles.

article_paragraphs.text: Hello! I am Lily. This is my family. Mom is my mother. Dad is my father. Tom is my brother. I am his sister. We have a small dog. His name is Pip.
Grandma and Grandpa come to the house. "Hello, Lily!" says Grandma. "Hi, Grandma!" I say. Grandpa is happy. Pip runs to Grandpa. "Woof!" says Pip. "Hello, Pip!" says Grandpa.
Mom, Dad, Tom, and me. Grandma and Grandpa, too. How many people? There are six of us! Six people and Pip. I love my family. My family is happy.
